title: Find the names of countries where matches were played in the 2008/2009 seas
question: Find the names of countries where matches were played in the 2008/2009 season by teams from leagues that had above-average build-up play passing in 2012.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_002"
FROM Country AS c
JOIN Match AS m ON c."XCL_001" = m."XCL_007"
WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2008/2009'
  AND m."XCL_008" IN (
    SELECT l."XCL_003"
    FROM League AS l
    JOIN Team AS t ON l."XCL_003" = t."XCL_170"
    JOIN Team_Attributes AS ta ON t."XCL_171" = ta."XCL_177"
    WHERE ta."XCL_178" LIKE '2012%'
    GROUP BY l."XCL_003"
    HAVING AVG(ta."XCL_181") > (
      SELECT AVG(ta2."XCL_181")
      FROM Team_Attributes AS ta2
      WHERE ta2."XCL_178" LIKE '2012%'
    )
  )
